lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Rumani,

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: are you okay?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Don't worry about the gym.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Epinel and I are holding down the fort.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Yeah,

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: don't worry about things over here.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Where are you right now?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I just stepped outside for some fresh air.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Would you like us to tag along?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I appreciate your concern,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: but right now, I need some time alone

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: to sort out my thoughts.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Okay,

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: but if you're having a hard time and need someone,

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: feel free to reach out anytime.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: We'll go straight to where you are.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: That's right. We'll head over right away!

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: We've got your back, Rumani!

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: We know how hard you've worked for this.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Yeah, we know all about it.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Argh, I'm so angry!

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: If they're going to write an article, the least they could do is get their facts straight.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: What's the point of doing an interview when the article's already out?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: By then, the public will have already made up their minds.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: It's just so frustrating >:(

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: It's happened more than a few times,

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: but it never gets any easier.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Oh well, what's done is done.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Thank you all for your concern.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I'll reach out later.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: In the meantime, stay strong and keep working hard for me.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: You too, Rumani.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Yeah, hang in there!
